```yaml
id: vuln-oneuptime-07bc6d4e
languages:
  - typescript
message: Detected potential improper authorization vulnerability
severity: ERROR
metadata:
  CVE: CVE-2025-65966
  CWE: CWE-285
pattern: |
  $X = @TypeORM.TableAccessControl({
    create: [Permission.Public],
    read: [Permission.CurrentUser],
    delete: [Permission.CurrentUser],
    update: [Permission.CurrentUser],
  })
taint-mode:
  taint-arg:
    - "$X.create"
    - "$X.read"
    - "$X.delete"
    - "$X.update"
```
This Semgrep rule will detect the usage of `TableAccessControl` with `create`, `read`, `delete`, and `update` permissions set to `Permission.Public`. It will not match the patched behavior where these permissions are set to an empty array.
